events.title: Fossil Group (FOSL) Reports Q1 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
events.body: Fossil Group (FOSL) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +86.36% and +9.50%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Analysts Estimate Urban Outfitters (URBN) to Report a Decline in Earnings: What to Look Out for
events.body: Urban Outfitters (URBN) doesn't possess the right combination of the two key ingredients for a likely earnings beat in its upcoming report. Get prepared with the key expectations.
